simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תׇּכְנִית (H8508) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תׇּכְנִית (toknîyth) means admeasurement , i.e. consummation First listed occurrence: Ezek 28 12.

definitions.full: H8508. toknith תָּכֵּנִית noun feminine measurement, proportion ; — absolute Ezek 43:10 (< read ᵐ5 נִיתוֺ תָּכְּ Ew Hi Co Toy and others); ת ׳חוֺתֵם 28:12 thou wert one sealing up (the) measure (RVm), i.e. exhibiting perfect proportion; Manuscripts Sm and others ת ׳חוֺחַם the seal of (perfect) proportion ; but dubious, see Commentaries
